recipe.visualDefinition: A large-scale impasto oil portrait of a male figure whose torso is composed of a collage of smaller, monochromatic performance snapshots. The style features heavy, visible brushwork and a warm, earthy palette contrasted by bold, left-aligned stenciled typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central portrait acting as a container for smaller narrative vignettes
High-contrast black and white stenciled text against a textured, warm background
Rough impasto textures in the background versus smoother, high-contrast photographic elements in the foreground
Vertical hierarchy moving from bold display text to fine metadata
coreInvariants: Collage-style integration of sub-images into the main figure's clothing
Warm sepia and ochre color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central, oversized head-and-shoulders portrait dominates the frame, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark, stenciled name at the top left serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, down the left-aligned column, then across the face to the detailed collage elements in the suit.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides textured negative space to balance the dense typography and collage on the left and bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre, cream, and burnt sienna in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark umber for the primary typography and collage shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and orange streaks within the tie and background textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black text and the light, textured background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and stencil-style grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky strokes with horizontal stencil gaps
Secondary text uses a condensed, high-contrast slab serif with stencil breaks
Metadata uses a clean, sans-serif grotesque for legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal breaks in vertical stems of 'A', 'M', and 'N'
Heavy, squared-off serifs on the secondary title lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, dark sans-serif stencil and a lighter, white slab-serif stencil.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line separating text blocks
Collage masking within the subject's silhouette

avoid: Clean, modern digital sans-serifs without texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky display feel with horizontal breaks
Provides the condensed slab-serif skeleton for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an impasto oil painting of a man's head and shoulders. The background should be textured with cream and ochre brushstrokes. The man's suit and tie area should be a collage of various small, monochromatic, vintage-style performance photos and concert posters blended into the painting's texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned, stenciled typography in the top left corner. The top line should be black and extremely bold. Below a thin horizontal line, add three lines of white stenciled slab-serif text. Below that, add smaller white sans-serif metadata text.

verificationChecks: Is the main portrait rendered with thick, visible impasto brushstrokes?
Are the smaller photos integrated into the suit silhouette?
Does the typography feature horizontal stencil breaks?
Is the color palette restricted to warm, vintage earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Number of collage elements in the suit
Width of the stencil gaps in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the biographical text

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of collage and painting
avoid: Clean vector lines in the background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the stencil cuts
Check that the collage elements don't overwhelm the main portrait's form
Verify the impasto texture is consistent across the entire canvas
Confirm the left-aligned text block creates a strong vertical axis
recipe.reuseFormula: Impasto Portrait + Silhouette Collage + Stencil Typography + Earth Tone Palette
